summary: Stages of the lab order workflow.
purpose: Define which stages every job sent to a lab (prostheses, crowns, aligners…) goes through, in what order, after how many days in a stage the order is considered overdue, and who to notify when an order reaches a stage or is overdue.
tips: There must be exactly one initial stage (every new order starts there) and at least one final stage (for example Completed or Cancelled).
A stage that has or had orders is not deleted: it is deactivated. If it still has orders, you choose which stage they move to.
Stage names are written by the clinic and are not translated.
List changes apply when you press Save. Alerts of an already saved stage are saved from their window, unless the page has other pending changes.

Each stage can alert when an order arrives and when it is overdue. In the stage the order is sent to, overdue means past its due date (suggested from the stage days and editable); in the others, past the stage days. Each alert reads as a sentence (“Alerts the order’s doctor in the app”); “Customize” adds roles, users, email or WhatsApp and repetition. Alerts also go to the Alert Center.

config.lab-stages.section.active.label: Active stages
config.lab-stages.section.active.description: One row per stage, in workflow order: drag them by the handle on the left. Each has a color, name, type (initial, intermediate or final) and the number of days after which an order in that stage is overdue (empty = no limit; final stages have none).

config.lab-stages.section.inactive.label: Deactivated stages
config.lab-stages.section.inactive.description: Stages no longer in use that do not show on the board. They can be reactivated.

config.lab-stages.section.issues.label: Review the configuration
config.lab-stages.section.issues.description: What is missing before you can save: a single initial stage, at least one final stage, and complete, unique names.

config.lab-stages.btn.add.label: Add stage
config.lab-stages.btn.add.description: Adds an intermediate stage before the final ones.

config.lab-stages.btn.discard.label: Discard changes
config.lab-stages.btn.discard.description: Goes back to the saved setup and drops unsaved changes.

config.lab-stages.btn.save.label: Save
config.lab-stages.btn.save.description: Saves the whole configuration at once. If a stage with orders was deactivated, its orders move to the chosen stage at that moment.

config.lab-stages.btn.alerts.label: Alerts
config.lab-stages.btn.alerts.description: Opens the stage alerts. The number shows how many are set up.

config.lab-stages.btn.alerts-first.label: Alerts (first stage)
config.lab-stages.btn.alerts-first.description: The bell of the first non-final stage. Same as the others: opens that stage's alerts.

config.lab-stages.section.alert-enter.label: When an order reaches this stage
config.lab-stages.section.alert-enter.description: Alerts every time an order moves into this stage. The sentence says who and how; the buttons pick the order’s doctor or its creator.

config.lab-stages.section.alert-dwell.label: If an order is overdue
config.lab-stages.section.alert-dwell.description: Alerts when the order goes over the stage’s overdue days or, in the stage it was sent to, the day after its due date; once or every X days (in Customize). Only for non-final stages with overdue days.

config.lab-stages.section.new-stage.label: New stage
config.lab-stages.section.new-stage.description: The stage just added, not saved yet. Drag it by the left handle into place.

config.lab-stages.field.new-name.label: Name
config.lab-stages.field.new-name.description: Stage name; written by the clinic and not translated.

config.lab-stages.field.new-kind.label: Type
config.lab-stages.field.new-kind.description: Initial (only one: every new order starts there), intermediate or final (the order ends and is no longer pending).

config.lab-stages.field.new-overdue-days.label: Overdue days
config.lab-stages.field.new-overdue-days.description: Days in the stage after which the order is marked overdue. Empty: no limit. Final stages have none. In the stage an order is sent to, they suggest the due date (today + these days) and that date becomes the deadline.

config.lab-stages.btn.apply-alerts.label: Save / Apply
config.lab-stages.btn.apply-alerts.description: If the stage is already saved and the page has no other changes, “Save” saves the alerts right away. Otherwise “Apply” keeps them on the stage and they are saved with the page’s Save.

config.lab-stages.toggle.alert-doctor.label: Order’s doctor
config.lab-stages.toggle.alert-doctor.description: Turns the alert to the order’s doctor on or off.

config.lab-stages.toggle.alert-creator.label: Order creator
config.lab-stages.toggle.alert-creator.description: Turns the alert to whoever registered the order on or off.

config.lab-stages.btn.customize-enter.label: Customize
config.lab-stages.btn.customize-enter.description: Shows the alert’s roles, users and channels (app, email, WhatsApp with a template).

config.lab-stages.btn.customize-dwell.label: Customize
config.lab-stages.btn.customize-dwell.description: Shows the alert’s repetition, roles, users and channels.
